clips.title: The story
paras: A silvery ribbon marks the Runed Scroll found in Kalimdor's wilds as a formal message from across the border. Finding it sends Horde scouts to the Mor'shan Rampart to warn its guards of activity to the north.

A fine silvery ribbon binds the scroll, unlike the rough leathers and parchment common in the Barrens. Its craft and script point to the night elves beneath Ashenvale's canopies to the north. With every ridge and road contested, a message taken from the enemy could matter greatly to the Horde's front lines.

The scroll belongs with local command, not at the Warchief's hall in Orgrimmar. Kadrak, an orc warrior, watches the border from the Mor'shan Rampart, where the Barrens' red earth meets Ashenvale's forests. Bringing the scroll to this outpost gives its guards word of night elf troop movements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?
There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well now... Where did you find this?
